Proposed immune escape mechanism of MDV via UL13 by regulating cGAS–STING, NFKB, and PKR-eIF2A pathways to inhibit the production of IFN, TNF, and CXCL9

A proposed immune escape mechanism of MDV via UL13 by regulating cGAS–STING, NF-κB, and PKR-eIF2α pathways to inhibit the production of IFN, TNF, and CXCL9. This schematic integrates current findings with prior literature; specific interactions are hypothetical and proposed as potential pathways for future study. See text for description.
